title: Craft Blend 4-Mix Trio #08 (L:가로 띠·물결 / C:대각 띠·물결 / R:세로 띠·물결)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Emirati woman in her mid 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smoky bronze eyes, a soft nude lip, warm golden-tan skin, an elegant composed expression, cheerful, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 28% of the way down her figure from the top, about 50% of the way down her figure from the top and about 77% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Islamic geometric star-tile pattern (a dense precise pattern of interlocking eight-pointed stars), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense geometric star-and-polygon tile filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in Portuguese azulejo tile (a brilliant white ground with deep cobalt-blue floral borders), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, dense repeating panel scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense lattice linework filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto studded boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Japanese woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair skin, bright pastel pink and yellow eyeshadow, thick lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, small star and heart stickers on the cheeks only, glossy candy-pink lips, a bright, giddy grin, demure and soft, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 diagonal bands by 3 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 32% of the way down her figure from the top, about 53% of the way down her figure from the top and about 71% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), wide silver bands following the contours of the body, dense optical illusion grid filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Nigerian Adire indigo resist-dye (a deep indigo-blue ground with bold white resist-dyed motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, dense spiral resist motifs filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the diagonal band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in Egyptian Mamluk brass-and-enamel inlay (a deep black ground with fine gold and silver geometric star inlay), wide gold-and-silver bands following the contours of the body, dense geometric star inlay filling the space between bands. Region 4 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense morphing tessellation filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: full side profile, one arm reaching forward, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme ankle-strap stilettos, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Swedish woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, very pale, cool skin, a soft white-silver highlighter along the cheekbones, nose bridge and brow bones, pale icy-blue eyeshadow with a fine silver shimmer, pale softly brushed blonde brows, curled light-brown-tipped lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, a sheer frosted pale-pink lip, a cool, calm, faraway expression, demure and soft, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes. Long round nails, matte finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 4 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 29% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 48% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 70% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Romanian Horezu ceramic (a cream ground with green, brown and ochre spiral floral motifs), wide ochre bands following the contours of the body, dense spiral floral bands filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain (a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels), wide gold-and-red bands following the contours of the body, dense overglaze florals filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it is painted in Polish Bolesławiec pottery (a deep cobalt ground with bold white peacock-eye dot motifs), wide white bands following the contours of the body, dense peacock-eye dot motifs filling the space between bands. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following the contours of the body, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between bands. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring patterns dissolve into each other, motifs from one thinning out as motifs from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one pattern, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: wide lunging stance, one leg forward, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Right woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto studded boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
